title: SOME OF HEBER'S FAMILY HISTORY--A PATRIARCHAL HOUSEHOLD--NAMES OF HIS
author: Orson F. Whitney
note: Published 1888. Whitney (grandson, later apostle). 68 chapters. Incorporates extensive verbatim journal extracts.

footnotes.text: The star attached to names in this chapter signifies deceased.
Names marked thus, whether living or dead, unknown.
Widow of Hyrum Smith, sealed to Heber for time.
At the funeral of his wife Vilate, Heber, pointing to the coffin, said: "There lies a woman who has given me forty-four wives."
